correctness.rationale: Exact factorial moments lead to R_j. The uniform all-j bound |R_j-1+δ(j)_2/2| <= K_t j^4/r² is proved by small-index logarithmic inequalities and large-index domination. Absolutely convergent factorial-moment inversion gives the explicit global signed ell-one remainder; reverse triangle inequality and Poisson moment continuity give the positive sharp TV constant and completion correction. Exact rational independent-group enumeration matches small distributions and verification script reproduces finite sample checks.

value.rationale: The natural fixed-round critical covering window has nontrivial chance of complete collection; the work supplies the exact leading discrepancy to Poisson calibration and a uniform explicit finite-n signed law. This improves the quality and interpretation of an established approximation for a standard combinatorial-probability object.
